title: Salty liquid water on the Martian surface

tellings.quote: in 2015 researchers stunned the world when they claimed to have finally found definitive evidence of salty liquid water flowing on the surface of Mars

plain: In 2015, researchers claimed to have found firm evidence of salty liquid water flowing on the surface of Mars, and Michels says the news "stunned the world". He tells it himself, without naming a source, on a 2025 episode with the remote viewer Joe McMoneagle about whether Mars once had life. He raises it because liquid water would make past or present life on Mars more plausible.
